name: Every Attempt Failed
template: The danger → the question → the rule that makes it hard → numbered attempts, each failing in a new way → the one that worked, step by step → loop back

beat_sheet.purpose: The danger, in the second person, shown as a see-through or dramatic scene.
The plain question the viewer now has.
The one physical rule that makes the problem hard, with a callout on the key part.
Numbered attempts, each with a badge and a verdict; each fails in a new way until the last.
The design that worked, step by step in cutaways, with one or two hedged figures on meters.
A last line that returns to the opening picture.

structure_variants.shape: Attempts in the order history tried them, oldest first.
Attempts grouped by how they failed: each new failure teaches the next fix.
Open on the attempt that almost worked, rewind to the first, then forward to the answer.

music_policy: Original beds only, rendered in-house or generated with commercial rights. No licensed or library music.
rules: Every attempt fails in a NEW way; the last one works.
Numbers are sourced or hedged; the part is named, never the brand.
Never copy another video's script, topic order or wording.
